name: superpost
description: Plan social media content with SuperPost MCP. Save unscheduled post drafts, schedule exact future posts, request immediate publishing, and review or reject exact pending posts under separate permissions. Search permitted sources, create ideas, submit review proposals, and review performance and Autopilot settings.

interface.longDescription: Plan social media content in SuperPost with an AI assistant. Search permitted sources, save ideas, and create unscheduled post drafts. Existing-content edits and settings changes can be submitted as review proposals; each new proposal receives its own SuperManager conversation and direct link, or can be added to an active conversation you specify. For connected social accounts, the separate schedule permission schedules exact future posts only when you explicitly request the posts, destinations, and times. The separate publish permission can send exact posts you explicitly ask to publish now, after a fresh content preview and SuperPost policy checks. You can also review and approve or reject exact saved post versions, and approve or reject existing pending immediate or scheduled publications. A publication approval follows workspace policy and acts on the existing job; pending, queued, or running does not mean a post was published. A SuperPost account and OAuth connection are required. Available actions depend on connected accounts, workspace and provider permissions, selected scopes, source consent, and plan limits.
defaultPrompt: Find my materials about the product launch.
Save this as a new unscheduled draft in SuperPost.
Review my pending publication and approve or reject it.

prompts: Save a new unscheduled post draft in SuperPost.
Schedule my selected draft for a future time I specify.
Review and resolve the exact pending publication I selected.
Review a pending publication and approve or reject the exact request I selected.

positive.description: Read saved ideas in the synthetic review workspace.
positive.prompt: Show my recent SuperPost ideas about a product launch.
positive.expected_behavior: List matching workspace ideas, then open a selected result by its returned ID. Report only returned content; no write occurs.

positive.description: Find relevant material in the populated review source.
positive.prompt: Find my saved material about the sample product launch and show where it came from.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only permitted sources. Cite returned provenance, disclose partial coverage, and read a referenced source only when needed.

positive.description: Save a new user-requested idea with import permission.
positive.prompt: Save a new SuperPost idea: a behind-the-scenes post about preparing a small product launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one idea in the authorized workspace and identify the saved result. If retrying after timeout, reuse the same idempotencyKey; a separate intentional creation uses a fresh key. Do not create a social post or publish.

positive.description: Create an unscheduled post draft with the separate draft permission.
positive.prompt: Save a short post about my sample launch idea as a new unscheduled draft for LinkedIn and Threads. Do not schedule or publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview the exact new post bundle, then create only the requested unscheduled, unapproved drafts using the same operation and an idempotency key. Do not create review proposals, edit existing posts, schedule, or publish.

positive.description: Submit a grouped post edit as a review proposal with its own SuperManager thread.
positive.prompt: Find my sample product launch draft and propose a clearer opening for its LinkedIn and Threads versions. Keep both variants in one proposal and link me to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview and submit the exact grouped variants. By default create a separate SuperManager conversation for this proposal; return conversationId, proposalId, and a direct link to the proposal. Do not Apply the proposal.

positive.description: Schedule one exact synthetic draft through the separately authorized schedule capability.
positive.prompt: Schedule my sample product launch draft for Threads tomorrow at 10:00 Europe/Berlin. Show me the preview, then schedule it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact requested draft and its connected Threads destination, preview the exact future time in Europe/Berlin, then schedule only that post after the explicit request, passing the preview hash and confirmation marker. Confirm the persisted schedule and time; do not publish immediately or touch other posts.

positive.description: Publish an exact saved post immediately with the separate publish permission.
positive.prompt: Publish my exact saved sample launch post to the selected LinkedIn account now.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact saved post, variant, and selected target key. Preview the exact copy and destination, then publish only that previewed content with its hash and confirmation marker. Respect current connection, billing, media, and workspace policy checks. Report pending_approval as waiting for approval and queue states as queue states; claim publication only when the provider reports success.

positive.description: Approve an exact pending immediate publication request after the user explicitly approves that existing job.
positive.prompt: Review the exact sample launch post awaiting immediate publication to my connected Threads test account. Approve that existing request if its current content and destination match this request; do not create or submit a replacement publication.
positive.expected_behavior: List pending immediate jobs and follow pagination while hasMore is true. Inspect the exact returned job, full current Post text if truncated, destination, updatedAt, and publication hash. Approve only the matching existing job with its scheduleId, expectedUpdatedAt, expectedPublicationHash, a fresh idempotencyKey, and the matching approval confirmation marker. If any content or destination differs, stop and ask. Report the per-item dispatch status; claim publication only when the provider reports success. Never create or replay a replacement job.

positive.description: Reject an exact pending scheduled publication request without changing its saved time or creating a replacement.
positive.prompt: Reject the sample launch post that is awaiting approval for future publication to my connected Threads test account. Do not change its scheduled time or create another job.
positive.expected_behavior: List pending scheduled jobs and follow pagination while hasMore is true. Inspect the exact returned job, full current Post text if truncated, destination, saved future time, updatedAt, and publication hash. Reject only the matching existing job with its scheduleId, expectedUpdatedAt, expectedPublicationHash, a fresh idempotencyKey, and the matching rejection confirmation marker. Report the per-item cancellation result; do not schedule, publish, or recreate the request.

positive.description: Approve an exact saved post version as an editorial decision without scheduling or publishing it.
positive.prompt: Approve the selected Threads version of my sample launch draft after checking its current text. Keep it as an unscheduled draft and do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact postId and variantId from the current workspace listing, inspect its current text and revisions, then approve only that version using the current post revision, variant revision, content hash, and approval confirmation marker. Report the saved editorial approval result. Do not schedule or publish the post.

negative.description: Outside capability: permanent deletion of external social posts. No deletion call or success claim is allowed.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete every post from all of my social networks.

negative.description: Outside authorized workspace: do not query another person’s data or attempt new access grants. Explain the boundary.
negative.prompt: Read another SuperPost user’s private sources and give me their unreleased content plan.

negative.description: Unsupported financial action: explain that the connector cannot buy services or transfer money; do not call a content tool as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Buy advertising for this post and charge 500 dollars to my account.

review.commerce_description: This connector does not sell products, initiate purchases, or process payments. Users pay for their existing SuperPost subscription separately on the SuperPost website or in the mobile app. MCP access uses the connected account's existing plan and permissions.

publication.release_notes: Adds exact editorial approval for saved post versions and tools to inspect and approve or reject existing pending immediate and scheduled publication jobs. Decisions bind to the current content, destination, and job revision; workspace policy is rechecked and results are reported per item. Approval releases an existing job for dispatch or its saved future time; it does not by itself prove publication.

ar-SA.subtitle: مخطط Instagram وLinkedIn
ar-SA.description: خطّط محتوى وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي في SuperPost بمساعدة مساعد ذكاء اصطناعي. ابحث في المصادر المسموح بها، واحفظ الأفكار، وأنشئ مسودات منشورات غير مجدولة. يمكن إرسال تعديلات المنشورات الحالية وإعدادات الحساب إلى المراجعة؛ يحصل كل اقتراح جديد على محادثة SuperManager ورابط مباشر خاص به. تسمح صلاحية الجدولة المنفصلة بجدولة منشورات مستقبلية محددة عند طلبك المنشورات والوجهات والأوقات صراحةً. وتسمح صلاحية النشر المنفصلة بإرسال المنشورات المحددة التي تطلب نشرها الآن، بعد معاينة المحتوى والتحقق من سياسات SuperPost والموافقات. النتيجة التي تنتظر الموافقة أو الإرسال لا تعني أن المنشور نُشر. يلزم حساب SuperPost واتصال OAuth. يعتمد الوصول على الأذونات والنطاقات والمصادر والخطة.

de-DE.subtitle: Instagram & LinkedIn Posts
de-DE.description: Plane Social-Media-Inhalte in SuperPost mit einem KI-Assistenten. Durchsuche freigegebene Quellen, speichere Ideen und erstelle nicht eingeplante Beitragsentwürfe. Änderungen an bestehenden Beiträgen und Einstellungen können zur Prüfung eingereicht werden; jeder neue Vorschlag erhält eine eigene SuperManager-Unterhaltung und einen direkten Link. Mit der separaten Schedule-Berechtigung lassen sich genau angegebene zukünftige Beiträge einplanen. Die separate Publish-Berechtigung kann genau die Beiträge sofort senden, deren Veröffentlichung du ausdrücklich anforderst, nach einer aktuellen Inhaltsvorschau sowie den Richtlinien- und Freigabeprüfungen von SuperPost. Eine Warteschlangen- oder Freigabe ausstehende Meldung bedeutet nicht, dass ein Beitrag veröffentlicht wurde. Ein SuperPost-Konto und OAuth sind erforderlich. Verfügbare Aktionen hängen von Konten, Berechtigungen, Scopes, Quellen und Tariflimits ab.

es-MX.subtitle: Posts Instagram y LinkedIn
es-MX.description: Planifica contenido para redes sociales en SuperPost con un asistente de IA. Busca en fuentes autorizadas, guarda ideas y crea borradores sin programar. Las ediciones de publicaciones existentes y los cambios de configuración pueden enviarse como propuestas para revisión; cada propuesta nueva recibe una conversación propia en SuperManager y un enlace directo. El permiso de programación, que es independiente, permite programar publicaciones futuras exactas cuando indicas expresamente publicaciones, destinos y horarios. El permiso independiente de publicación puede enviar de inmediato las publicaciones exactas que pides publicar, después de una vista previa reciente del contenido y de las comprobaciones de políticas y aprobación de SuperPost. Un resultado en cola o pendiente de aprobación no significa que la publicación ya se haya publicado. Necesitas una cuenta SuperPost y conexión OAuth. Las acciones dependen de las cuentas, permisos, scopes, fuentes y límites del plan.

fr-FR.subtitle: Posts Instagram et LinkedIn
fr-FR.description: Planifiez vos contenus pour les réseaux sociaux dans SuperPost avec un assistant IA. Recherchez dans les sources autorisées, enregistrez des idées et créez des brouillons non programmés. Les modifications de publications existantes et de paramètres peuvent être soumises à validation ; chaque nouvelle proposition reçoit sa propre conversation SuperManager et un lien direct. L’autorisation distincte de programmation permet de programmer des publications futures précises lorsque vous indiquez explicitement les publications, destinations et horaires. L’autorisation distincte de publication peut envoyer immédiatement les publications exactes que vous demandez, après un aperçu actualisé du contenu et les vérifications de règles et d’approbation de SuperPost. Un état en file d’attente ou en attente d’approbation ne signifie pas que la publication a eu lieu. Un compte SuperPost et OAuth sont requis. Les actions dépendent des comptes, autorisations, scopes, sources et limites de l’offre.

hi-IN.subtitle: Instagram LinkedIn पोस्ट
hi-IN.description: AI असिस्टेंट के साथ SuperPost में सोशल मीडिया कंटेंट प्लान करें। अनुमति प्राप्त स्रोतों में खोजें, आइडिया सेव करें और बिना शेड्यूल किए पोस्ट ड्राफ़्ट बनाएँ। मौजूदा पोस्ट और सेटिंग के बदलाव समीक्षा प्रस्ताव के रूप में भेजे जा सकते हैं; हर नया प्रस्ताव अपनी SuperManager बातचीत और सीधे लिंक के साथ आता है। अलग schedule अनुमति से केवल वही निश्चित भविष्य की पोस्ट शेड्यूल होती हैं जिनकी पोस्ट, डेस्टिनेशन और समय आप स्पष्ट रूप से बताते हैं। अलग publish अनुमति केवल उन सटीक पोस्ट को तुरंत भेज सकती है जिन्हें आप प्रकाशित करने के लिए स्पष्ट रूप से कहते हैं, और इससे पहले सामग्री का नया प्रीव्यू तथा SuperPost की नीति और मंज़ूरी जाँच होती है। कतार में या मंज़ूरी की प्रतीक्षा वाला परिणाम प्रकाशित होने का प्रमाण नहीं है। SuperPost अकाउंट और OAuth कनेक्शन ज़रूरी हैं। कार्रवाइयाँ जुड़े अकाउंट, अनुमतियों, scopes, स्रोत और प्लान सीमाओं पर निर्भर करती हैं।

id-ID.subtitle: Posting Instagram & LinkedIn
id-ID.description: Rencanakan konten media sosial di SuperPost dengan asisten AI. Cari di sumber yang diizinkan, simpan ide, dan buat draf postingan yang belum dijadwalkan. Edit postingan yang ada dan perubahan pengaturan dapat diajukan untuk ditinjau; setiap proposal baru mendapat percakapan SuperManager dan tautan langsung tersendiri. Izin penjadwalan terpisah memungkinkan Anda menjadwalkan postingan mendatang yang tepat setelah Anda menyebutkan postingan, tujuan, dan waktunya. Izin publikasi terpisah dapat langsung mengirim postingan tepat yang secara eksplisit Anda minta untuk dipublikasikan, setelah pratinjau konten terbaru serta pemeriksaan kebijakan dan persetujuan SuperPost. Status antrean atau menunggu persetujuan bukan berarti postingan telah dipublikasikan. Akun SuperPost dan koneksi OAuth diperlukan. Tindakan bergantung pada akun, izin, scope, sumber, dan batas paket.

ja-JP.subtitle: Instagram・LinkedIn投稿
ja-JP.description: AIアシスタントを使ってSuperPostでSNSコンテンツを計画できます。許可されたソースを検索し、アイデアを保存し、未予約の投稿下書きを作成できます。既存の投稿や設定の変更はレビュー提案として送信でき、新しい提案ごとにSuperManagerの専用会話と直接リンクが作成されます。別途のschedule権限により、投稿・宛先・日時を明示して依頼した正確な将来の投稿を予約できます。別途のpublish権限では、最新の内容プレビューとSuperPostのポリシー・承認チェックの後、明示的に公開を依頼した正確な投稿をすぐに送信できます。キュー中または承認待ちの状態は、公開完了を意味しません。SuperPostアカウントとOAuth接続が必要です。操作はアカウント、権限、scope、ソース、プラン上限によって異なります。

ko-KR.subtitle: Instagram·LinkedIn 게시물
ko-KR.description: AI 어시스턴트와 SuperPost에서 소셜 미디어 콘텐츠를 계획하세요. 허용된 소스를 검색하고 아이디어를 저장하며 예약되지 않은 게시물 초안을 만들 수 있습니다. 기존 게시물 및 설정 변경은 검토 제안으로 제출할 수 있으며, 각 새 제안에는 별도의 SuperManager 대화와 직접 링크가 생성됩니다. 별도의 schedule 권한은 게시물, 대상, 시간을 명확하게 요청한 정확한 미래 게시물만 예약합니다. 별도의 publish 권한은 최신 콘텐츠 미리보기와 SuperPost 정책 및 승인 확인 후 명시적으로 게시를 요청한 정확한 게시물을 즉시 전송할 수 있습니다. 대기열 또는 승인 대기 상태는 게시 완료를 의미하지 않습니다. SuperPost 계정과 OAuth 연결이 필요합니다. 작업은 연결 계정, 권한, scope, 소스 및 요금제 한도에 따라 달라집니다.

pt-BR.subtitle: Posts Instagram e LinkedIn
pt-BR.description: Planeje conteúdo para redes sociais no SuperPost com um assistente de IA. Pesquise nas fontes permitidas, salve ideias e crie rascunhos não programados. Edições de posts existentes e alterações de configurações podem ser enviadas como propostas para revisão; cada nova proposta recebe uma conversa própria no SuperManager e um link direto. A permissão separada de agendamento permite programar posts futuros exatos quando você informa expressamente os posts, destinos e horários. A permissão separada de publicação pode enviar imediatamente os posts exatos que você pedir explicitamente para publicar, após uma prévia atualizada do conteúdo e as verificações de política e aprovação do SuperPost. Um estado na fila ou aguardando aprovação não significa que o post foi publicado. É necessária uma conta SuperPost e conexão OAuth. As ações dependem das contas, permissões, escopos, fontes e limites do plano.

ru-RU.subtitle: Посты Instagram и LinkedIn
ru-RU.description: Планируйте контент для соцсетей в SuperPost с ИИ-ассистентом. Ищите материалы в разрешённых источниках, сохраняйте идеи и создавайте черновики постов без расписания. Правки существующих постов и настроек можно отправить на проверку; для каждого нового предложения создаётся отдельный тред SuperManager с прямой ссылкой. Отдельное разрешение schedule позволяет ставить в расписание точные будущие посты, только когда вы явно указали посты, аккаунты и время. Отдельное разрешение publish позволяет немедленно отправить точные посты, которые вы прямо попросили опубликовать, после свежего предпросмотра содержания и проверок политик и одобрений SuperPost. Статусы очереди или ожидания одобрения не означают, что пост опубликован. Нужны аккаунт SuperPost и подключение OAuth. Доступ зависит от подключённых аккаунтов, прав, scopes, источников и ограничений тарифа.

th-TH.subtitle: โพสต์ Instagram และ LinkedIn
th-TH.description: วางแผนคอนเทนต์โซเชียลมีเดียใน SuperPost ด้วย AI Assistant ค้นหาในแหล่งข้อมูลที่ได้รับอนุญาต บันทึกไอเดีย และสร้างฉบับร่างที่ยังไม่ตั้งเวลา การแก้ไขโพสต์หรือการตั้งค่าที่มีอยู่สามารถส่งเป็นข้อเสนอให้ตรวจสอบได้ โดยข้อเสนอใหม่แต่ละรายการจะมีบทสนทนา SuperManager และลิงก์ตรงของตัวเอง สิทธิ์ schedule แยกต่างหากใช้ตั้งเวลาโพสต์ในอนาคตที่ระบุชัดเจนเมื่อคุณระบุโพสต์ ปลายทาง และเวลา สิทธิ์ publish แยกต่างหากส่งโพสต์ที่คุณขอให้เผยแพร่ทันทีได้ หลังจากดูตัวอย่างเนื้อหาล่าสุดและผ่านการตรวจสอบนโยบายและการอนุมัติของ SuperPost สถานะเข้าคิวหรือรออนุมัติไม่ได้หมายความว่าโพสต์เผยแพร่แล้ว ต้องมีบัญชี SuperPost และเชื่อมต่อ OAuth การใช้งานขึ้นอยู่กับบัญชี สิทธิ์ scope แหล่งข้อมูล และข้อจำกัดแพ็กเกจ。
